text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INCIDENT fired -> hosted-inference-prod: HIGH error rate on api/redwood/v1/generate. Policy: hosted-inference-prod -> primary-oncall -> secondary-oncall -> manager

incident-bot: Details: incident_key=INC-987654, service=hosted-inference, started=2026-03-15T02:14:36Z, symptoms=5xx spike, latency spike, customers experiencing intermittent failures. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-987654 :rotating_light:

eva (oncall): I see the PD page. jumping in — looking at metrics now. @jordan if you have logs pls paste

jordan: logs look like rapid 503s from inference pool a-3, kube nodes hitting OOM-ish liveness restarts. snippet: ```2026-03-15T02:13:58Z host-a3 inference: model-serving: OOM when allocating KV cache, aborting request```

sam: got alerts too, console shows request queue rising and continuous batching timeouts. Might be a model rollout with bigger memory.

eva (oncall): acking in PD now. 

oncall-bot: PagerDuty: Acknowledged by eva (oncall) at 2026-03-15T02:15:04Z :white_check_mark:

jordan: weird — PD UI still shows "triggered" on the incident timeline for the primary step, I see no active acknowledgement via the API. PD events show an ack then an immediate unack (race).

eva (oncall): I clicked ack twice and got the UI green. if it's ephemeral on PD side maybe webhook/retry issue. what's policy look like?

oncall-bot: Escalation: Primary ack not stabilized, next step (secondary-oncall) will be notified in 90s per policy window.

sam: secondary will be @maria? she might be sleeping (timezone). If PD escalates we might get manager wake. Do we want that now?

jordan: I'd rather have secondary get it — but the PD webhook shows our ack flip is causing a duplicate escalate event to fire. This looks like PagerDuty duplicate-event/race.

eva (oncall): ok trying to force a stable state: running `pd incident acknowledge INC-987654 --user eva` to confirm via CLI.

jordan: CLI returns 200 ack but then webhook v2 returns duplicate trigger from monitoring tool 02:15:10 causing re-trigger.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation fired to secondary-oncall -> maria (manager) (because primary state unstable) at 2026-03-15T02:16:10Z :bell: 

maria (manager): pinged via PD SMS. I'm awake, joining — putting phone on loud. Joining bridge: https://call.example/bridge/hosted-inference-987654

eva (oncall): thanks @maria — quick context: spike in 503s, logs show OOMs in a-3, likely bad model bundle or changed batch size. immediate mitigation options: 1) scale up inference pool (costly) 2) pin traffic to smaller model variant 3) kill rollout pods that got new image 4) enable fallback routing to Dedicated fallback pool.

sam: I can scale nodes but autoscaler is saturated in that AZ. Recommend immediate fallback routing to dedicated-fallback that has spare capacity. That should reduce customer impact quickly.

jordan: Running runbook step: `./runbook fallback-route --incident INC-987654 --to dedicated-fallback`  (will post output)

ops-bot: Command accepted: fallback-route start -> job-id=fb-20260315-01. Posting progress updates.

ops-bot: fallback-route job fb-20260315-01: routed 42% of traffic to dedicated-fallback in 60s, error-rate dropping. new errors reduced from 24% -> 6% for sampled keys.

eva (oncall): monitoring shows latency back to normal on the sampled routes. customer impact decreased. 👍

maria (manager): good. we still got a manager escalation because of PD race. We should capture that as a tooling bug. Who owns PD webhooks? @jordan

jordan: I'll open a ticket for PD webhook dedup + add idempotency. quick mitigation: I'm going to temporarily add a PD filter rule to suppress duplicate triggers for this service for 10m.

jordan: `pd rules add --service hosted-inference --suppress-duplicates 600` -> applied.

eva (oncall): can we get a short post-incident note in #incidents after stabilization? include timeline and the PD duplicate event cause. Also want to track any customer complaints for the window 02:13-02:20.

sam: I'll collect a sampled list of affected customer request IDs and contact CS if any paid accounts hit errors > 15% in that window.

ops-bot: fallback-route job complete -> routed 100% of eligible traffic to dedicated-fallback. All monitored error rates stable for 5m. Closing mitigation job.

eva (oncall): confirming final: incident is still open in PD but impact mitigated. I'll stay on until runbook complete then handoff to next oncall for postmortem.

maria (manager): thanks team. action items: 1) PD webhook dedupe ticket (jordan) 2) Add idempotency in oncall CLI (devex) 3) Review model rollout gating for KV cache size (research/eng-ml) 4) Customer outreach if billing-tier affected (sam/customer-success). I'll open a tracker and assign.

jordan: noted — filing PD webhook ticket INC-TKT-1221 and linking this thread.

eva (oncall): handoff: staying on for 10 more minutes then will escalate to night-oncall if needed. If PD re-triggers, use fallback-route abort/reapply pattern: `./runbook fallback-route --abort job-id` then re-run.

sam: thanks — good quick triage. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-987654 status=acknowledged (mitigation in progress) at 2026-03-15T02:22:00Z

end of thread: no further escalation.
